# Micro QR reference symbols from segno 1.6.6 (https://github.com/heuer/segno), one block per
# case: a JSON line with the options and segno's selected symbol and mask, then the modules.
# segno writes zero bits as padding in M1 and M3, while ISO/IEC 18004:2015 section 7.4.10
# requires the alternating pad codewords 11101100 and 00010001 before the final 4-bit
# codeword. These references were generated with segno patched to follow section 7.4.10;
# every other module comes from segno unchanged.
